name: WdPasteOptions
description: Indicates how to paste copied text.

constants.name: wdKeepSourceFormatting
constants.description: Keeps formatting from the source document.

constants.name: wdMatchDestinationFormatting
constants.description: Matches formatting to the destination document.

constants.name: wdUseDestinationStyles
constants.description: Matches formatting to the destination document using styles for formatting.
